statement: All meaningful physical PCM output bytes matched the generated stimulus after the pinned clients’ transformations. Pixel stereo 8-kHz 16-bit trials produced 31980 and 39990 bytes per internal channel after its documented first 60-byte skip and final padding; iczero mono chunks produced 40000 bytes per channel matching its float32 scaling by 0.9. At initial peak 1024 the owner felt both sides, hearing the right more clearly; at peak 4096/32767, equal 440-Hz 500-ms left/right windows were clean and clearly heard/felt through both clients. These are byte correspondence and qualitative feedback, not calibrated acoustic frequency/loudness, a separate speaker endpoint, USB Audio Class or USB MIDI.
